quality_assessment: Chapter is highly accurate and comprehensive. Minor improvements possible by documenting --no-require-git flag and adding cross-references to related topics.

issues.description: Chapter doesn't mention --no-require-git flag which affects directory traversal in non-git directories
issues.should_add: Document that by default ripgrep only respects .gitignore when inside git repository, and --no-require-git can override this
issues.fix_suggestion:
Add subsection or note explaining:
- Default behavior: .gitignore only respected inside git repos
- --no-require-git: Use .gitignore rules even outside git repos
- --require-git: Explicitly enforce git repository requirement
This is relevant to recursive search because it affects which directories are descended into.

issues.description: Could expand on error handling behavior mentioned briefly
issues.current_content: Handles errors gracefully (e.g., permission denied on directories)
issues.should_be: Provide concrete example of how permission errors are displayed and that search continues
issues.fix_suggestion: The Troubleshooting section mentions permission errors, but could add a note in the main 'How Directory Traversal Works' section with specific example of error message format

issues.should_add: Add --no-require-git and --require-git to the summary table
issues.fix_suggestion:
Add row to summary table:
| --no-require-git | | Use .gitignore outside git repositories |
| --require-git | | Only respect .gitignore inside git repos (default) |
